title: Nested While Loop with Early Break
description: Demonstrates structured control flow with inner and outer OpLoopMerge headers and loop-exit merge points
disassembly:
%bb_entry = OpLabel
OpBranch %bb_outer_header
%bb_outer_header = OpLabel
OpLoopMerge %bb_outer_merge %bb_outer_continue None
OpBranchConditional %cond_outer %bb_inner_header %bb_outer_merge
%bb_inner_header = OpLabel
OpLoopMerge %bb_inner_merge %bb_inner_continue None
OpBranchConditional %cond_inner %bb_inner_body %bb_inner_merge
%bb_inner_body = OpLabel
OpBranch %bb_inner_continue
%bb_inner_continue = OpLabel
OpBranch %bb_inner_header
%bb_inner_merge = OpLabel
OpBranch %bb_outer_continue
%bb_outer_continue = OpLabel
OpBranch %bb_outer_header
%bb_outer_merge = OpLabel
OpReturn

title: SSA Phi Join from Multi-Way Branch
description: Illustrates OpPhi node resolving divergent value definitions across conditional branches prior to function return
disassembly:
%bb_entry = OpLabel
OpSelectionMerge %bb_join None
OpBranchConditional %cond %bb_then %bb_else
%bb_then = OpLabel
%val_then = OpFMul %float %a %b
OpBranch %bb_join
%bb_else = OpLabel
%val_else = OpFAdd %float %a %b
OpBranch %bb_join
%bb_join = OpLabel
%res = OpPhi %float %val_then %bb_then %val_else %bb_else
OpReturnValue %res
